title: ns-3 to E2 agent IPC, version 1
description: Newline-delimited JSON over TCP, one object per line, UTF-8, at most 1 MiB per line, ns-3 -> agent only in v1. ns-3 writes the identical line to its local trace before sending, so the trace is the wire. Non-finite doubles are encoded as null. Doubles use shortest round-trip decimal so values compare bit-exactly. Receivers ignore unknown keys; a new key bumps 'minor', a breaking change bumps 'v'. Minor 1 adds 'control' (agent -> ns-3, an RC handover control the agent decoded) and 'controlAck' (ns-3 -> agent, its outcome). Minor 2 adds lock-step pacing: hello 'pacing' ('free', the default, or 'lockstep'), 'tStartS' and 'tGateS'; 'step' (agent -> ns-3) once the agent has handled sample k, seq -1 meaning ready. In lock-step a control is applied at the barrier after sample afterSeq; one that reaches a later barrier is answered refused/late. Minor 3 adds 'ueContext' (ns-3 -> agent), which carries the node's UE contexts for the KPM UE IDs; it is sent on the same connection before the sample of a seq whenever the node's UE context set changed, and each line replaces the node's whole set; ns-3 writes it to e2-ue-context-<node>.jsonl, never to the ipc trace. Minor 4 makes 'control' name the UE by 'ueId' {mEnbUeX2apId, mnCellId}, the en-gNB-UEID of the E2SM-RC CONTROL Style 5 action 3 request the agent decoded, instead of 'imsi', and renames the controlAck cause 'unknownImsi' to 'unknownUe' (a UE ID that resolves to no UE of the node); 'control' keeps v 1. Wall-clock values appear only inside 'diag'.

nodeId.description: ns-3 cellId of the E2 node (LTE eNB = 1, mmWave gNBs = 2..1+N in scenario-zero).

section.description: Measurement values keyed by the exact name ns-3 builds today (the AddItem name, or the C++ field / CSV column name for container and file-logging-only values). The metric map (metric-map.v1.json) maps each key to a KPM measName.

simStartEpochMs.description: Wall-clock epoch ms that ns-3 maps to sim time 0 (MmWaveHelper start time); the agent builds the KPM TimeStamp from it.

reducedPmValues.description: Informational only; samples always carry the full set.

tStartS.description: Minor 2. Start barrier timeout (s): the wait for every agent's step -1.

tGateS.description: Minor 2. Barrier timeout (s): the wait for every agent's step k.

l3.description: L3 RRC SINR as ns-3 computes it (mmWave CU-CP; LTE from the file-logging path).

cuCp.description: A section (values keyed by ns-3 name) plus the l3 object. additionalProperties sits in this same schema so that it does not apply to l3 (inside allOf it would reject l3).

seq.description: 0-based per run and node; incremented for every built sample, including dropped ones.

simTimeNs.description: Simulator time when the sample was built (end of its period).

ipcDropped.description: Cumulative samples this node's emitter has dropped (agent down or backpressure).

nodeId.description: Node whose agent received the RICcontrolRequest (viaNodeId).

ctlId.description: Agent-monotonic id; the agent's pending key.

ueId.description: Minor 4. The UE ID of the RIC Control Header: en-gNB-UEID {m-eNB-UE-X2AP-ID, globalENB-ID macro eNB ID}. ns-3 resolves it to the UE whose LTE RNTI at the master eNB is mEnbUeX2apId and whose master eNB is mnCellId.

mEnbUeX2apId.description: MeNB UE X2AP ID, ENB-UE-X2AP-ID INTEGER (0..4095).

mnCellId.description: The master eNB's 20-bit macro eNB ID, as an integer (its ns-3 cellId).

afterSeq.description: Last sample seq the agent had received when it forwarded the control.

diag.description: Diagnostics only (wall clock); excluded from digests.

seq.description: Sample seq of the period boundary the control was handled at.

step.description: Minor 2, agent -> ns-3, lock-step only: the agent has handled sample seq (seq -1: E2-ready with a subscription). Counters are cumulative.

ueContext.description: Minor 3. ns-3 -> agent: every UE of the node (a gNB: the UEs in its UE map; the eNB: all of its UEs) with the IDs the agent reports in KPM Format 2 (gNB: en-gNB-UEID {m-eNB-UE-X2AP-ID = lteRnti, globalENB-ID macro eNB ID = mnCellId}; eNB: eNB-UEID {mME-UE-S1AP-ID = mmeUeS1apId, gUMMEI, m-eNB-UE-X2AP-ID = lteRnti}). For the UE ID the IMSI only maps sample UEs to these IDs: it is never encoded as the KPM UE ID (the UEID CHOICE carries en-gNB-UEID or eNB-UEID only). The agent refuses a line with a value outside its range (and clears the node's set), and does not encode a sample whose UE has no context.

seq.description: Seq of the sample this line precedes.

ues.description: Sorted by imsi, each imsi at most once.

lteRnti.description: The UE's RNTI at the master LTE eNB (the X2AP UE ID); ENB-UE-X2AP-ID is INTEGER (0..4095).

mnCellId.description: cellId of the master LTE eNB: its 20-bit macro eNB ID.

mmeUeS1apId.description: The UE's MME UE S1AP ID (ns-3 sets it to the IMSI).
